summary: Iteration-8 narrow retest executed on public preview for shared autoplay hover/focus/play matrix only. Prior high bug (hover pause while pointer inside) is fixed, but two Celebrity focus-related behaviors still fail; BeadJourney and reduced-motion checks pass.

ui_bugs.issue: Keyboard focus on another carousel control does not pause autoplay. Repro: start Play on Milind, move mouse outside, focus [data-testid='patron-next'], wait 6.2s => Milind advances to Dimple.

ui_bugs.component: Celebrity manual select -> Play with retained focus
ui_bugs.issue: After manual selection pause, clicking Play then keeping focus on Play and pointer outside does not resume after 5.6s (remains Milind).

integration_issues.issue: browser automation tool context does not support true tap/hasTouch; synthetic touch fallback used. Celebrity did not advance in fallback while BeadJourney advanced.

action_items: Fix Celebrity focus-state interaction so non-Play keyboard focus pauses autoplay until blur.
Fix Celebrity manual-select->Play flow so explicitPlay reliably resumes while Play button focus is retained and pointer is outside.
Run one true mobile touch-context verification (has_touch=true, is_mobile=true) outside current automation limitation to confirm Celebrity touch behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: useVisibleSequence toggle/focus interplay appears order-sensitive: explicitPlay can be cleared by focus capture around Play interactions, causing inconsistent focused-play behavior in Celebrity.
The exact prior failure is resolved: while hovered inside carousel for >6s, Milind remains stable; leaving hover resumes Dimple then Sunanda.
BeadJourney matrix remains healthy after shared-hook change (manual select pause + Play with focus held + pointer outside resumes correctly).

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (focused matrix: key hover fix PASS, 2 celebrity focus-path FAIL, reduced-motion PASS, BeadJourney PASS)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reliable PASS from final run: Case1 exact reproduction now passes (Milind held during hover >6s; after pointer leave at ~6.6s Dimple; next tick Sunanda). BeadJourney manual-select pause + Play+pointer-outside while focus held passes. Reduced-motion no-auto passes for both sections. Remaining deterministic fails are Celebrity focus pause and Celebrity manual-select->Play focused resume paths.
rca of the issue: Likely race/order issue between focus capture and explicitPlay state in shared hook usage: expected gate is enabled&&!reduced&&!paused&&!hovered&&(!focused||explicitPlay)&&!hidden&&visible&&count>1. Observed failures indicate focused states in Celebrity can both (a) continue when they should pause (focus another control) and (b) block when they should resume (manual-select then Play with retained focus). This suggests explicitPlay/focused transitions are not consistently synchronized during control focus changes in Celebrity interactions.
